    • findControllerInMtab

      protected String findControllerInMtab(String controller, Map<String,Set<String>> entries)
      Find the hierarchy of the subsystem. The kernel ensures that a subsystem can only be part of a single hierarchy. The subsystem can be part of multiple mount points, if they belong to the same hierarchy.
      Parameters:
      controller - subsystem like cpu, cpuset, etc...
      entries - map of paths to mount options
      Returns:
      the first mount path that has the requested subsystem
